preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is an integer between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(N, int) and 6 <= N <= 1000 for N in [int(line.strip()) for line in stdin_text.split('\n')[1::2] if line.strip()])
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is an integer between 6 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(x, int) and 0 <= x <= 10**9 for x in [int(v) for v in line.split()]) for line in stdin_text.split('\n')[2::2] if line.strip())
preconditions.description: For each test case, the N integers are non-negative and at most 10^9.
It is guaranteed that a solution exists within the operation limit.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout_lines) == sum(1 + M for M in [int(stdout_lines[i]) for i in range(0, len(stdout_lines), 1) if i % 2 == 0 and i < len(stdout_lines)])
postconditions.description: The output structure matches the format: for each test case, one line with M followed by M lines of operations.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= M <= 11111 for M in [int(stdout_lines[i]) for i in range(0, len(stdout_lines), 1) if i % 2 == 0])
postconditions.description: The number of operations M for each test case is between 0 and 11111 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(all(x in current_board for x in [int(v) for v in line.split()]) for line in stdout_lines[1::2] if line.strip() and (current_board := [int(v) for v in next_test_case_input.split()]))
postconditions.description: Each operation references three integers that are currently present on the blackboard at that step.

postconditions.expression: all(all(x == 0 for x in final_board) for final_board in [simulate_operations(initial_nums, ops) for initial_nums, ops in zip(parse_initial_numbers(), parse_operations())])
postconditions.description: After performing the specified operations, all numbers on the blackboard are 0.
